units.note: Numbers checked: 1000 talents, half the term, 24 years, >500 and just under 700 quinqueremes engaged, losses ~700 Roman / ~500 Carthaginian. Chapter ends mid-sentence in the Greek; the English trailing dash preserves the break.
Opening '[...]' correctly marks the continuation from ch. 63 (καθίκοντο τῆς προθέσεως).
